summary: Frontend-only E2E test of redesigned /persona-panels page. All 18 requested functionalities verified via Playwright: seed panel auto-loads with 5 personas (Priya, Arun, Meera, Devika, Farhan) rendered as horizontal cards; constraint summaries derived correctly (Arun 'Can't click — keyboard only', Meera 'Sees only the accessibility tree, no visuals', Devika 'Views at 2× zoom'); Arun click chip is line-through @ opacity 0.5 while Meera click chip is normal; action chip toggle flips text-decoration on click; perception mode is icon+dropdown; frustration/temperature are inline number inputs; tolerance rules render as tag list with add/remove; panel-selector dropdown present; Broad/Focused toggle present; Run button disabled with empty URL and enabled when URL provided; Generate button disabled with empty audience; all 5 nav items present.

issues: Cards overflow horizontally as designed but the last card (Farhan) is partially clipped at 1920px width without a visible scroll indicator/gradient — users may not realize 5th card exists. Consider fade/arrow affordance.

Constraint summary reads only 'Gives up after 3 frustrating steps.' — for personas with no disability the summary feels thin; consider adding a positive statement like 'Full perception, no constraints.'

critical_code_review_comments: PersonaPanels.jsx is 713 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting PersonaCard, RuleTag, SaveTick, and the constraint helper into separate files under components/persona-panels/.
handleGenerate/handleSaveNew/handleDelete swallow errors with empty catch blocks ('/* silent */') — user gets no feedback on failure. Wire to toast/error boundary.

scheduleAutoSave uses eslint-disable for exhaustive-deps and captures state via closure — race conditions possible if two fields updated within 1.5s of each other; last-scheduled wins is OK but no error surfaced if save fails.
fetchPanels uses eslint-disable and calls loadPanel from inside — should be a stable ref or included in deps.
Generate button uses raw axios instead of the shared api client (generatePersonas helper) — DRY issue carried over from previous iteration.
Run button navigates to /new-run?panel=&target= even when activePanelId is null (empty panel param). Consider blocking when no active saved panel or auto-saving before nav.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only interacted with existing seed-demo panel (auto-save triggered but only benign field flips reverted via subsequent toggle).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesigned PersonaPanels page fully functional. All data-testids listed in the task exist. If retesting, note the auto-save fires 1.5s after any field change — the action-chip toggle test in this iteration flipped Priya's 'scroll' action off then it remained off (auto-saved). May want to restore state or use a copy-panel. Constraint summary logic is in constraintSummary() at top of PersonaPanels.jsx.
